about.title: About | Nomad Spin
about.description: Learn about Nomad Spin, a travel discovery tool helping digital nomads find their next base with data-driven city recommendations.
about.orgDescription: Travel discovery tool for digital nomads and remote workers.
about.intro: Nomad Spin is a travel discovery tool built for digital nomads, remote workers, and long-term travelers. We help you cut through decision paralysis and find your next destination based on what actually matters: cost of living, internet speed, safety, and vibe.
about.database: Our database covers 780+ cities worldwide with figures on budgets, internet, safety, visa rules, coworking density, and more. Some of those records are estimates, and every page says which. Each city is scored against your own preferences.
about.value.discovery.title: Discovery First
about.value.discovery.desc: We prioritize serendipity. Spin the globe and let the data surprise you.
about.value.numbers.title: Numbers, not ads
about.value.numbers.desc: Scores and rankings use the city figures and your preferences. Partner links have no input.
about.value.gaps.title: Honest about gaps
about.value.gaps.desc: Estimates are tagged, missing figures say "No data", and the methodology page lists what we do not know yet.
about.feedback: Have feedback or a city suggestion? <link>Get in touch</link>.
contact.title: Contact | Nomad Spin
contact.description: Get in touch with the Nomad Spin team. Share feedback, suggest a city, or ask a question.
contact.intro: Have a question, feedback, or a city you'd like us to add? Drop us a message.
contact.wrongNumber: Spotted a wrong number on a city page? Tell us which city and which figure, with a source if you have one.
contact.thanks.title: Thank you!
contact.thanks.body: We'll get back to you soon.
contact.form.name: Name
contact.error: Failed to send message. Please try again.
contact.prerender.intro: Share feedback, suggest a city, or tell us about a wrong number. The contact form on this page needs JavaScript to send.
contact.prerender.report: If you report a figure, name the city and the figure, and add a source if you have one.
notFound.title: Page Not Found (404) | Nomad Spin
notFound.description: This page doesn't exist. Head back to Nomad Spin to spin the globe and find your next digital nomad destination.
prerender.compare.p1: Pick two to four cities. Each row shows who leads and where the data runs out. There is no overall winner, because the right city depends on what you weigh.
prerender.compare.p2: Rows cover monthly cost, long-stay cost, internet speed and reliability, safety, visa route and stay length, climate and community. A missing figure shows "No data". Estimates and formula values are tagged.
prerender.compare.examples: Examples: <link1>Lisbon and Porto</link1>, <link2>Chiang Mai and Bangkok</link2>.
prerender.findYourBase.p1: {count} cities, ranked against your needs. Set a monthly budget, a preferred temperature, a minimum internet speed, a minimum safety score and the stay length you want. Then weight each one.
prerender.findYourBase.p2: Every score is explained line by line under "Why this score". A city that is over your budget or below a minimum is flagged, and you can hide those cities with one switch.
